metadata.name: collection-page-layout-phone
metadata.description: Verify collection and inspector placement on phone and reject horizontal page overflow.

evaluate.expression: (() => {const a=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-collection-primary]').getBoundingClientRect(),b=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-collection-inspector]').getBoundingClientRect(); const wide=window.innerWidth>=896; if(wide ? !(b.x>=a.right && Math.abs(a.y-b.y)<2) : !(b.y>=a.bottom && Math.abs(a.x-b.x)<2))throw Error('Incorrect collection/detail layout');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>window.innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');return {wide,collection:{x:a.x,y:a.y,width:a.width},inspector:{x:b.x,y:b.y,width:b.width}};})()
